subject: Partner discovery recap + scheduling partner-led demo/tech deep dive
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob.chen@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's partner discovery

Hi Soojin — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed path forward: 

- Recap: Nimbus is evaluating marketplace integration to surface Redwood models in our managed cluster offering. Key use cases: customer-facing chat assistants and internal embeddings for search.
- Priorities: security posture (tenant isolation + KMS), billing/marketplace contract flow, and a quick proof-of-concept to validate latency/throughput.

Can we schedule a partner-led session where Redwood's marketplace/partner PM and an SE can walk our platform team through the integration pattern and expected operational burdens? Ideally that session includes: 1) high-level marketplace flow, 2) technical deep dive (integration steps, service account scopes, sample API calls), and 3) next-step checklist for a POC.

Suggested windows (PDT):
- Tue 2027-09-21, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2027-09-22, 14:00–15:00

If those don't work, we can pivot to the following week. Bob (cc) will own the technical side and can provide a lower-level environment the week of the POC.

I've attached our intake spreadsheet (partner-intake.xlsx) with contact points and initial environment notes.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Integrations | NimbusCloud
att: partner-intake.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's partner discovery

Alice — really appreciate the clear recap. Great fit and we should run this as a partner-led session exactly as you outlined. 

Quick notes and proposal:
- Owner/roles: Camila will lead the marketplace/integration flow and handle contract/marketplace questions; Marcus (SE) will own the technical deep dive and POC checklist. I'm the engagement lead and will coordinate scheduling and pre-read.
- Proposed slots (PDT) — pick one and we'll send an invite:
  * Tue 2027-09-21 10:00–11:00 (preferred)
  * Wed 2027-09-22 14:00–15:00

Camila/Marcus — can you confirm availability for these two slots? Marcus, please confirm you'll have 45–60 mins for a deep dive covering auth, KV cache/latency expectations, and sample API calls (we'll include a short perf spreadsheet).

I've attached a short agenda for the partner session (nimbus-demo-agenda.pdf) and a one-page SE runbook (se-runbook.md) that Marcus can expand. Alice — once we lock a slot I'll send a calendar invite and include the Drive link for pre-read. For scheduling convenience here is a booking link: https://cal.redwood.ai/soojin/30min

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Partner Growth Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice@nimbuscloud.com>, Bob Chen <bob.chen@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's partner discovery

Thanks team — I'm available for both windows but have a calendar conflict on Tue morning with a marketplace ops review; Wed 14:00–15:00 works best for me. Marcus — can you do Wed at 14:00 PDT?

A couple of prep asks for Alice/Bob:
- Please share the AWS account ID or marketplace identifier you'll use for the POC (we need it to walk provisioning flows).
- If you have any tenant network restrictions (eg. IP allowlist), note them in the shared intake doc so Marcus can align the SE demo environment.

I'll draft the invite and include the attached agenda + runbook. We'll cover: 1) high-level marketplace flow, 2) runtime expectations (latency/throughput targets), 3) provisioning steps and required service scopes, 4) POC success criteria and timeline.

Attaching agenda stub for final review (nimbus-demo-agenda.pdf).

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
att: nimbus-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob.chen@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's partner discovery

Perfect — Wed 2027-09-22 14:00–15:00 PDT works for us. Please send the calendar invite when ready.

Action items from Nimbus before the session:
- I'll populate the AWS account ID and IP allowlist into the intake sheet today.
- Bob will prepare a short tenant export (example keys/permissions) we can share during the deep dive.

If Camila/Marcus want anything else ahead of time (sample logs, expected traffic profile), tell us and we'll upload to the Drive link you shared: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1NimBus-Intake

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Alice
